title: In Trump’s Diplomacy, Insults Are a One-Way Street. Ukraine Is the Latest Example.
partialText: The latest rift with President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine serves as a reminder that President Trump readily lashes out at other world leaders, only to grow outraged if they fight back.

title: What Putin Gains From Releasing an American Prisoner
partialText: After Russia released an American prisoner, President Trump’s special envoy praised President Vladimir V. Putin as “a humanitarian.” Our White House and national security correspondent, David E. Sanger, describes how the release comes amid Mr. Trump’s broader shift toward Russia and away from Ukraine.

title: Russia Releases American Stephen Hubbard From Prison, State Media Reports
partialText: The move buys good will with President Trump while costing the President Vladimir V. Putin — who is wanted for war crimes — little.

title: When Starshield Cut Out, Ukrainian Drones Fell From the Skies
partialText: Ukraine says it still doesn’t know why the military satellite internet service, a sister to Starlink, was abruptly throttled, leaving troops vulnerable to Russian attacks.

title: A Billionaire Wanted a Trump Pardon. His Family Gave Alina Habba a $50 Million Deal.
partialText: Julio Herrera Velutini, a prominent Venezuelan, was seeking clemency. He got it not long after his daughter gave Ms. Habba, a lawyer close to President Trump, an extraordinarily lucrative job.

title: Abdul El-Sayed Confronts Attacks on His Faith and Family Ties
partialText: In the final weeks of Michigan’s Senate race, the Democratic nominee finds himself facing both ugly attacks and pointed questions about family members. He has pushed back forcefully.

title: Trump Approval Hits New Low Two Weeks Before Midterms, Poll Finds
partialText: Likely voters favored Democratic candidates over Republicans by 11 percentage points in their congressional district, a New York Times/Siena poll found.

title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion for Deceiving Users on Privacy
partialText: The penalty, one of the largest levied against the tech giant, stemmed from a lawsuit by New Mexico claiming the social media company had misled users about their data privacy.

title: Inside the World of ‘Dark Nutrition’
partialText: More Americans are rejecting everything they’ve been taught about food.

title: What We Saw at Fast-Track Trials of Riot Suspects in France
partialText: At the Tribunal de Paris, judges have supervised a carousel of expedited and often chaotic hearings for those detained during recent unrest.

title: France Riots Expose the Rage Aimed at Dior, Hermès and Other Luxury Brands
partialText: The looting of stores belonging to brands like Dior, Celine and Hermès has exposed a crack in the glossy facade.

title: Macron Says Trump Does Not Like France and Distorts Its Troubles
partialText: Speaking in Qatar, President Emmanuel Macron railed against foreign leaders who he said had made false claims about unrest in France for their own political ends.

title: Cardi B Is Using Her Music, Her Business and Her Politics to Express Herself
partialText: A shape-shifter with talent and personality to spare, the rapper keeps finding new ways to express herself.

title: Death Toll From Venezuela Quakes Likely Far Exceeds Official Count
partialText: A Times analysis and U.S. Geological Survey data indicate that the official 6,509 death toll is probably a severe undercount.

title: Cornell Case Highlights Shifting Federal Title IX Enforcement
partialText: From Barack Obama to Donald Trump, ideology has infused the interpretation of the federal law banning sex discrimination on college campuses.

title: Is Rabies Making a Comeback?
partialText: As several states report surges in animal cases, federal officials are warning about an apparent increase in human exposures.

title: How to Lower Your Alzheimer’s Risk if You Have the APOE4 Gene Variant
partialText: People with the APOE4 gene variant have more to lose from unhealthy habits — and potentially more to gain from healthy ones.

title: In Six Decades of Public Life, I Never Thought I Would Write This Piece
partialText: Trump’s meddling would have dark consequences for our democracy and our prosperity.

title: Everything Feels So Expensive. Here’s What’s Really Going On.
partialText: Whatever you call it, we can all agree this doesn’t feel good.

title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX and Tesla Are Exploring a Merger
partialText: A deal would consolidate Elon Musk’s holdings in rockets, cars and artificial intelligence into a company worth well over $3 trillion.
